mapper.select: select t.primary_key stock, t.picture, t.product_part_code, t1.product_part_sign, t1.model, t1.pcs, t2.pieces_sign pcsChn, t.total_inventory, t.total_inventory - t.lock_in_inventor canUseInventory, t.shipping_space::BIGINT[] positionCodes, t.count_cycle, t.state, case when t.state then '停用' else '启用' end stateChn, t.safe_inventory, t.remark from ${stockTableName} t left join ${productPartTableName} t1 on t.product_part_code = t1.primary_key left join ${piecesTableName} t2 on t1.pcs = t2.primary_key where t.enterprise_code = #{enterpriseCode} and t.primary_key = #{stockCode} and t.delete_flag = false

select t.primary_key stock, t.product_part_code, t1.product_part_sign, t1.model, t1.pcs, t2.pieces_sign pcsChn, t.total_inventory, GREATEST(total_inventory - lock_in_inventor, 0) canUseInventory, t.shipping_space::BIGINT[] positionCodes, t.count_cycle, t.state, case when t.state then '启用' else '停用' end stateChn, t.safe_inventory, t.remark, t.stock_init_state, t.bar_code_number, t3.type_name, t3.primary_key productPartTypeCode, t3.attribute, t.check_version, t.check_flag, t.stocktaking_type, CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ${positionStockBatchTableName} t4 WHERE t.primary_key = t4.stock_code and t.product_part_code = t4.product_or_part and t.shipping_space[1] = t4.position_code) THEN true ELSE false END AS haveBatchFlag, t.stock_limit, t1.unity_no from ${stockTableName} t left join ${productPartTableName} t1 on t.product_part_code = t1.primary_key left join ${piecesTableName} t2 on t1.pcs = t2.primary_key left join ${productPartTypeTableName} t3 on t1.product_part_type = t3.primary_key where t.delete_flag = false and t.enterprise_code = #{enterpriseCode} and t.primary_key = #{stockCode}
